conditions_of_stop: ledger transition not attributable to this approved campaign
pytest failure is not one exact assertion failure or its JUnit report is unavailable

criteria.acceptance: Existing initial-energy rtol=1e-12, final-energy rtol=1e-10, energy drift <1e-10, residual <1e-10; no general convergence claim.
criteria.oracle: Analytical initial strain energy for the one-free-DOF TET4 fixture, compared with the initial and final total energies; energy drift and dynamic residual assertions.
criteria.oracle_independence: The scalar strain-energy formula is evaluated independently from volume, modulus and initial displacement. The fixture assembly is not independently validated, and no closed-form displacement history is asserted.

selection.selection_basis: Single TET4 fixture: 12 total translational DDL, one free dynamic coordinate.
